notes.title: Achievements and UX improvements
notes.content:
Added Steam achievements (yup!)
 Mouse wheel now (un)zooms the map
 Removed the need to hit the talk button (auto-talk feature)
 Merged « fill » with « use » so you don’t get confused
 Added a gilded hidden item
 Automatically removed a few more items once they become useless
 Fixed the use of a forest ingredient
 Fixed some inner map displays
 Fixed a few typos and missing FX

notes.title: Simplified push, animations and some more
notes.content:
Character animation on the map
Discrete UI animations
Filtered out a lot of « push » actions and added a couple more to make the action more rewarding
Removed some useless items
Fixed a nasty bug with the fog of war inside buildings
Reinstated the use of the word « chandler »

notes.title: Less confusion all around
notes.content:
Display the name of rooms you have not yet visited on the city map
Changed accessibility toggle to Control + F12
Fixed a color, a price, an entrance too lenient and typos

notes.title: Small ergonomics and immersion changes
notes.content:
Removing the veil before talking
 Fixed issue with sound controls that were sometimes hard to grab
 Added tooltips for diary buttons (and especially the hint button)
 Fixed some display issue during the end credits

notes.title: Updates on stability, controls and accessibility
notes.content:
General updates

 Access to settings at the beginning of the tutorial
 Some straightening of hints when players do things in an unusual order
 Fixed a wandering ferrywoman
 Correcting a few bugs and typos

Accessibility updates

 New accessibility shortcut: F11 to toggle copy to clipboard on / off
 The screen reader now gives precedence to direct results of player interactions. History of potentially missed messages is still available through I and K
 More efficient browsing through screen reader story messages history

notes.title: Small improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
- Clarified use / fill actions
- Numpad enter key support
- Fixed an issue with a rope
- Prevented horses from entering some places they shouldn’t
- Display issue on the map when pausing
- Miscellaneous bugs and typos
